title: Configuration of this node
explain: Where the worker looks. The environment of the worker gives the root of each place (shown in grey); here you can only pick a sub-folder inside it. The worker checks the value before it is kept, and refuses anything that leads outside the root.
notSet: Not set by the worker's environment: set the matching variable on the worker first.
invalidNow: This value no longer works: the worker refuses it.
reason.not_found: No such folder inside the root.
reason.invalid: Plain names only (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore).
reason.not_configured: The worker's environment gives no root for this.
entrypointsHint: Names separated by commas, as in Traefik's static configuration (for example websecure). The site form starts from them.
readOnly: You can read these settings but not change them.
reason.forbidden: This is a project folder or the hub's own data: it cannot be used.
pickFile: Pick a file next to the root file.
truncated: The list is cut: type the name instead.
